recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If CDS wants new guidance for modeling alternate boolean combinations such as OR or XOR, handle that as a separate guidance issue rather than reopening the already-applied FHIR-13926 rule.
issue_request: FHIR-13926 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for STU3. It requested clarification for multiple PlanDefinition action conditions, including contradictory applicability conditions, and resolved that multiple conditions are combined using AND semantics, with the same clarification applying to RequestGroup and notes indicating how other behavior could be handled.
initial_application: SVN/Git commit 5a8d5223975c730d68f8711232a0c6727ce24a8e (SVN 13323) explicitly applied GF#13926 by adding AND-semantics comments to the then-authoritative PlanDefinition and RequestGroup spreadsheet sources. Later source refactors carried the text into current XML StructureDefinition sources, and FHIR-24619 renamed RequestGroup to RequestOrchestration.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists PlanDefinition and RequestOrchestration and maps RequestGroup to RequestOrchestration. Later Applied issue FHIR-46179 clarified the same comments to state that no applicability conditions means applicable and different condition kinds are considered separately, while preserving the same-kind AND rule. Zulip and Confluence checks found no conflicting substantive community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current PlanDefinition.action.condition and RequestOrchestration.action.condition comments already define the required AND semantics, and adding generic modifier-extension prose from the older resolution would be redundant with current implementer-facing conformance text.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied CDS issue updated the same condition comments for no-condition and different-kind semantics while preserving the FHIR-13926 AND rule.
Rename history explains why RequestGroup evidence is now checked in RequestOrchestration source.
